representedDate: Standing monastery and twentieth-century museum extensions, using the southwest photograph uploaded in 2006 and present mapped footprint.
wholePhysicalScope: The named six-corner museum polygon fixes the main envelope, and the signed southwest direction agrees with the native approach road and photographer’s caption.
lodDetails: All levels retain the stepped Mar Sarkis masonry, southwest entry, terraces and the limestone contact. Near levels add deep openings, arch blocks, balcony rails and metal grilles.
limitations: The exact mapped outline and valley-facing photograph constrain placement. Room heights, hidden roof layout, glazing proportions and the buried walls are estimates.

Local cliff forms and the terrace grade are reconstructed from the photograph, adjacent independent relief and contact margins. The original elevation field is unchanged. The tomb, interiors and paths beyond the immediate terrace are outside the modeled exterior.
